9c0e5dcee8f46c7b6a05.en: A pictogram uses symbols. The key tells you what one symbol means.
9c0e5dcee8f46c7b6a05.id: Piktogram memakai simbol. Keterangan (key) memberi tahu arti satu simbol.

11d89e56dc3b6e9e6be1.en: Each symbol means 2 books. Monday has 3 symbols.
11d89e56dc3b6e9e6be1.id: Setiap simbol berarti 2 buku. Monday punya 3 simbol.

1b2069eaa80f5ec5119d.en: A bar chart uses bars. Read across from the top of a bar to the scale.
1b2069eaa80f5ec5119d.id: Diagram batang memakai batang. Baca mendatar dari puncak batang ke skala.

46d9508010bfd50b2c05.en: The Blue bar reaches 10, so 10 children chose blue.
46d9508010bfd50b2c05.id: Batang Blue mencapai 10, jadi 10 anak memilih blue.

3846652c636ed3c2021e.en: Each symbol is 4, so 3 symbols is 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.
3846652c636ed3c2021e.id: Setiap simbol bernilai 4, jadi 3 simbol sama dengan 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.

5ff33bebd7c1f6548c76.en: Each symbol is 5, so 4 symbols is 4 × 5 = 20 pupils.
5ff33bebd7c1f6548c76.id: Setiap simbol bernilai 5, jadi 4 simbol sama dengan 4 × 5 = 20 murid.
